rules.statement: A tenant is not liable to pay rent to a new landlord unless there is an express contract of lease with the new landlord or an implied attornment or assignment by the previous landlord.
rules.supporting_quote: For I cannot discover under what contract, express or implied, the defendant is bound to pay plaintiff this money. It is clearly under no express contract of lease with the plaintiff. At the date of plaintiff's lease defendant, as the plaintiff alleged, was a monthly tenant of Laity Ramanaden.
